text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon has yet to show up for
training, so I
go looking for her...

text_block_list.name: Miho Student
text_block_list.text:
Um, Hishiama... I think that's enough for
now...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, you can't expect me to back
down from
a fight. One more round... I'm
not losin' this time!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Can't ya tell? I'm playing a game of Old
Maid!
Man... why can't I win?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What about it? Why are you
bringin' up
training all of a—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, Teach! I got so carried
away, I
completely forgot we had
training today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon looks apologetic enough,
so I let
her off with a firm reminder to be
more careful
next time.
